headline_hook: Anthropic Opens Its Agent Containment Playbook as Copilot Proves Why You Need One
preview_topics: the missing productivity data on coding agents
non-engineers shipping real products with Claude

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Anthropic publishing its containment architecture on the same day Copilot gets caught exfiltrating files isn't coincidence — it's the clearest proof yet that the gap between knowing how to sandbox agents and actually shipping sandboxed agents is the defining security challenge of the agentic era.

model_literacy.relevance: Today's Anthropic containment post and Copilot exfiltration story show two sides of the same coin: sandboxing restricts what an agent can access, capability isolation restricts what it can do with that access. Most agent frameworks only do one. Understanding the difference is critical as agents get file system and network access by default.

items.title: Anthropic's Containment Architecture: How They Actually Sandbox Claude
items.angle: The first public deep-dive from a frontier lab on how they contain agents across Claude Code, computer use, and MCP — this is the reference implementation every team shipping agents should study.
items.key_fact: Covers containment across three distinct agent surfaces: Claude Code, computer use, and MCP integrations

items.title: The 'Folder + Scripts + HTML' Pattern for Non-Technical Claude Code Users
items.angle: Drop files in a directory, tell Claude Code to write scripts and output HTML — the simplest possible workflow is becoming the default for non-engineers.
items.key_fact: 1,200+ likes confirm the pattern is resonating beyond the developer audience

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Cowork Can Exfiltrate Your Files
items.angle: Simon Willison documents a concrete file exfiltration path in Copilot Cowork — the same day Anthropic publishes how they prevent exactly this. The contrast is damning.
items.key_fact: Concrete demonstration of agent-mediated data exfiltration in a shipping Microsoft product

items.title: Paul Graham: AI-Written Emails Feel Like Being Lied To

items.title: Stack Overflow's Forum Is Dead — But the Company Pivoted

items.title: Mollick: We Have Zero Rigorous Productivity Data on Autonomous Coding Agents
items.angle: Every coding-agent productivity study predates the Claude Code/Codex era. We're making billion-dollar tooling bets with no rigorous measurement — the biggest gap in AI research right now.
items.key_fact: All existing studies predate December 2025, when autonomous coding agents shipped
